items.title: Three equivalent descriptions of the topology induced by an injective map
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the triple description of the topology induced by an injective map (author lemma at source lines 637-649, label lemma-induced): it is the weakest topology making the map continuous, its opens are the preimages of opens, and its closed sets are the preimages of closed sets. The proof (source lines 651-685) is a complete verification: the family of preimages is shown to satisfy the topology axioms (proof lines 652-660), minimality among topologies making the map continuous is checked (proof lines 660-676), and the closed-set description is obtained from the identity for preimages of complements (proof lines 677-684). The three descriptions are used as alternative definitions throughout the chapter's subsections on submersive maps. H2.
